Book correction: The condition is printed as x \ne 1. That is not enough: \tanh y always lies in (-1, 1), so \tanh^{-1} x exists only for |x| < 1; for x > 1 or x \le -1 the fraction \frac{1+x}{1-x} is negative or zero and its \ln is not defined. The correct statement is \tanh^{-1} x = \frac{1}{2}\ln\left(\frac{1+x}{1-x}\right), |x| < 1 (as in the 1.5.3 table).

Book correction: The condition is printed as x \ne 0. That is not enough: \operatorname{sech} y takes values only in (0, 1], so \operatorname{sech}^{-1} x exists only for 0 < x \le 1. For x > 1 the root \sqrt{1-x^{2}} is not real, and for x < 0 the fraction is negative, so the \ln is undefined. The correct condition is 0 < x \le 1 (as in the 1.5.3 table).
